task.title: Data quality and exploratory analysis
task.prompt: Build a self-contained pandas/matplotlib analysis using a DataFrame you construct in code (at least 12 rows) about monthly retail transactions with columns date, region, product, units, unit_price, customer_id. Intentionally include at least one missing value and one duplicate. Audit missingness and duplicates, clean them with justified choices, engineer revenue, report groupby revenue by region and monthly trend, and create at least two informative plots. Include assertions and concise evidence-based interpretation. Save plots in the current directory. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, rows_before, rows_after, missing_before, duplicates_before, total_revenue, regions. No network or external data.
